noProject.title: Open a project folder
noProject.body: Ylide works on a folder on this computer. Your files, chats and agent runs stay on this machine.

failed.title: The editor could not start
failed.body: Something went wrong while loading the code editor. Try again, and restart Ylide if it keeps failing.

welcome.body: Open a file from the sidebar or jump straight to one.

disk.changed: {{name}} changed on disk while you were editing it.
disk.deleted: {{name}} was deleted on disk. Saving creates it again.

closeDialog.title: Save changes to {{name}}?
closeDialog.body: Your changes are lost if you close the file without saving.

inline.title: Edit with AI
inline.noModel: No model is running. Start one to edit with AI.
inline.noChange: The model suggested no changes. Try a more specific instruction.
inline.noResult: The model did not return a result. Try again.

review.title: Review the change
review.acceptHint: Apply the change (Enter). Ctrl+Z undoes it.

tree.title: Files
tree.label: Files in {{name}}
tree.noProject: No folder is open. Open one to see its files.
tree.exists: A file or folder with this name already exists.

nameProblem.invalid: This name is not allowed. Avoid \ : * ? " < > | and empty folder names.

tree.deleteFileBody: {{path}} is removed from disk. This cannot be undone in Ylide.
tree.deleteFolderBody: {{path}} and everything in it is removed from disk. This cannot be undone in Ylide.

search.title: Search
search.globsHint: Comma-separated patterns. A leading ! excludes matching files.
search.truncated: Showing the first {{max}} results. Narrow the search to see the rest.
search.hint: Find text in every file of the project. Use the file filter to narrow it down.
search.noProject: Open a folder to search in it.

quickOpen.title: Go to file
quickOpen.placeholder: Type a file name, add :12 for a line
